sourceAssessments.area: Original resolve cap and monotone reproof horizon
sourceAssessments.assessment: Start is captured before validation/dispatch. Positive resolve uses min(originalStart+5000, originalStart+remainingMs) and checks again after executor settlement. Reproof reads and mutates the same current Held object after await, setting min(latestHeldDeadline, reproofStart+5000, reproofStart+freshRemainingMs) before final checks without another await. Same-epoch expiry stores a consumed deadline. Later or earlier-started overlapping larger observations cannot extend it.
sourceAssessments.testSource: authority.test.ts:355-439 covers response delay consuming validity, timer-independent positive cutoff, unchanged original cap, shorter still-valid horizon, same-epoch expiry and the earlier-started/larger-result overlap case using two deferred executor responses.

sourceAssessments.assessment: Positive rows require exact fixed tuple, nonterminal positive epoch and valid mode/duration. Absent/draft/revoked/expired resolve nonpositive; binding mismatch is unavailable. Changed epoch or selected revision/revoke prevents current reproof. Same-epoch finite expiry consumes local custody. Current is only an observation and cannot serve as a later separate transaction publication grant.

sourceAssessments.area: Four slots and actual executor settlement contract
sourceAssessments.assessment: Capacity is checked synchronously before dispatch, capped at four per adapter with no pending admission queue. The abort timer requests cancellation but does not race/detach the read promise. The slot and timer remain owned until the executor promise and result decoding settle; positive resolve/reproof then checks actual monotonic time and abort. No absolute wall-time guarantee can be derived for a noncompliant executor.
sourceAssessments.testSource: authority.test.ts:443-497 holds four promises unsettled across timer abort, refuses fifth calls, then reuses only settled slots. It also distinguishes settled rejection and reproof deadlines. This is adapter-control evidence only, not proof that real database acquisition/cancellation/drain occurred.

preciseLimits: This review executed no product code, tests, SQL, native runner, server, socket, database or network call.

Offline authority.test.ts uses synthetic rows, deferred promises, controlled monotonic time and mock timers. Those meaningful cases can validate adapter decisions, but cannot establish real SQL roles, locks, startup, PID+birth cancellation, target/control disappearance or per-call resource cleanup.

The actual native executor remains responsible for finite owned acquisition/abort/join, shared fixture admission, poison propagation to already active work, real target/control backend absence and fail-closed cleanup. It is not validated by these three runtime files or their fakes.

An approved/current read is preliminary. Actual later publication requires the separate owner-only post-all-waits method/proof/time transaction boundary; no complete M03/M04/Accepted composition is claimed.
Receipt lifetime is technical custody and remains distinct from one-time until_revoked/explicit-until method approval. No public p95, caller cancellation or longer U1/I1 budget is claimed.
Package checksum and a successful shared draft read do not prove package completeness, real method approval, source freshness or Dev target evidence.
No final native/whole-MA1 or current-main integration verdict is provided. Every later changed source/head requires its relevant renewed review/gates.
